sketches.mechanism: Rust moves ownership of non-Copy values and rejects any later use of the moved binding at compile time.
sketches.resonance: After a whole self is given away, the compiler refuses the old hand's claim to still possess it.

sketches.mechanism: SQL NULL comparisons yield UNKNOWN, and a WHERE clause returns only rows whose predicate is TRUE.
sketches.resonance: Absence cannot even prove itself to itself, so it vanishes from the answer.

sketches.mechanism: R function arguments are lazy promises evaluated only when the function body forces them.
sketches.resonance: The catastrophe is present as a promise, but because no one asks for it, it never happens.
